title: Recording: Song For John, What A Waste, What A Bastard The World Is by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Yoko Ono recorded three songs for her third album Approximately Infinite Universe on 19 October 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

The songs were ‘Song For John’, ‘What A Waste’, and ‘What A B*****d The World Is’. The first two were completed on this day, and mixed in stereo on 4 November.

‘What A B*****d The World Is’ took longer to complete. It was re-recorded on 24 and 26 October, and mixed on 5 November. However, strings were added on 20 November, and the song was finally mixed the following day.
